items.title: Ruth & Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Saddle River, New Jersey, January 19, 2015
items.q: And Les Paul called me and said, “boy is that you on it.”

ctx.x: Well what was so special about what you played? Because you told me —
I just played rhythm on that with “Georgia on My Mind.” Jump bomp-chink, bomp- chink. And Les Paul called me and said, “boy is that you on it.” He recognized it. Boy he loved it.
Was the whole group there? Because that song had strings on it and all that.
